method: Primary documents read with fetch_page during this session. Statements below are bounded excerpts/interpretations, not fabricated organizer measurements. Repeated automated DrivenData access disabled after Terms of Use review.

claims.claim: The competition target is geological faults indicative of geothermal resources, not verified geothermal vents or reservoirs.
Known-fault labels are incomplete and may contain inaccuracies. Initial test labels are new expert-mapped faults; the final round uses an expanded expert-reviewed label set.
The metric uses a 300 m triangular distance kernel and alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, with max-weighted coverage per truth pixel.
claims.status: verified primary source and independently tested arithmetic

claims.claim: Submission: one float32 data band, EPSG:32611, 100 m resolution, template-matching bounds, [0,1] predictions; the published text permits null or NaN outside bounds.
claims.status: verified primary source; actual mirror dimensions measured separately

claims.claim: Known USGS/INGENIOUS fault pixels are excluded from evaluation, in both rounds, and do not incur penalty terms.
The known-fault mask is pixel-exact. Off-mask predictions near known faults are penalized against NEW truth normally; new truth can lie within 300 m of known traces.
Organizers are not sharing additional hidden-label data sources, fault types or coverage. It is unsupported to claim the hidden labels are exclusively LiDAR-visible faults.
The official rules specify up to three submissions per week and selection of one final submission for both rounds. No slot was used by this implementation.
claims.section: 1.1 Single entry in two prize phases; 3.2 Process Overview
claims.status: rules verified; zero uploads is local execution evidence

claims.claim: Generative AI development is allowed, but use and extent must be disclosed in the submission narrative; finalists must supply reproducible code and documentation.
claims.status: verified primary rules; narrative included in repository

claims.claim: The public leaderboard observation in this session showed rank 1 at 0.3774; 0.3195 was rank 7. Participant scores do not authenticate the brief's filename-to-score mappings.
claims.status: dated official participant-level observation, not artifact-level proof

claims.claim: GeoDAWN Area 2 was flown at 400 m flight-line spacing, with variable terrain clearance. 100 m raster cells do not imply independent 100 m magnetic measurements. The release is marked CC0.

An integrated Great Basin study used structural setting, terminating/intersecting gravity gradients, magnetic and thermal evidence to investigate blind geothermal systems. This supports multi-physics investigation, not confirmation of these predictions.

INGENIOUS GDR 1391 is publicly accessible and CC BY 4.0, with free official links for wells/springs, geodetics, faults and other data. R2 does not use any of these third-party derived files as new labels.
claims.status: official metadata verified; R2 external-data use is false

claims.claim: Blum and Mitchell's analysis assumes sufficient compatible views and conditional independence for the pertinent theoretical result. Correlating proxy prediction errors is a diagnostic, not proof of those premises.
claims.section: Abstract, formal framework and theoretical analysis; DOI 10.1145/279943.279962

claims.claim: Mapping accuracy varies with source/scale and faults may conduct or impede fluids; surface topography alone does not verify a geothermal resource.
claims.status: primary scientific proceedings, not organizer hidden-label disclosure

claims.claim: The official data page redirected to login in this session. Core data were restored from owner mirrors and SHA-checked, not authenticated against an organizer download.
claims.status: access limitation verified; input integrity verified separately

claims.claim: DrivenData Terms prohibit robot/spider/automatic access and unauthorized monitoring/copying. Scheduled DrivenData scraping is disabled absent a documented permission.
